correctness.rationale: Write a nonzero rank-one linear map as P(X)=tr(FX)U, modulo reciprocal scaling. Expanding both averaging identities and nondegeneracy of the matrix trace pairing gives necessary and sufficient U²=λU, FU=UF=λF. For λ≠0 normalize U to unique image idempotent p, with F∈pM_np nonzero; this is a rank-s idempotent incidence vector bundle, irreducible dimension 2s(n−s)+s²=2ns−s². For λ=0, U²=0 and FU=UF=0. The supplied explicit t-dependent idempotents of rank n−r and functionals F_t, whose resulting endomorphism coefficients have no pole at zero, degenerate to each square-zero-image rank-r operator, so no additional reduced components exist. Distinct rank-s open strata remain separated under nonzero-idempotent limits. Counting images/kernels and GL_r gives E_{n,s}(q), Z_{n,r}(q), with scaling/(q−1); dominated convergence of normalized ranks yields the Rogers-Ramanujan density (qR(q^−1)−1)/(q−1). I independently verified exact finite-field count formulas at (n,q)=(2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(3,2), giving 24,112,330,1274; the infinite claims rest on algebraic arguments not finite checks.
